problem.decision_or_job: Resolve one bounded operational decision with auditable evidence
problem.trigger: validated work item enters the target queue
problem.current_state: Operators gather context across systems and resolve the item manually
pain_evidence: baseline measurement is scheduled during discovery

functional_requirement.decision: Select the permitted resolution for one eligible work item
functional_requirement.action: Stage an evidence-backed resolution for accountable review
functional_requirement.accepted_outcome: Operational owner accepts a verified workflow result

outcome.accepted_event: Operational owner accepts a verified workflow result
outcome.verifier: Independent rule, source-of-truth readback, or named reviewer confirms completion

eligible_population.definition: All work items entering the named low-risk workflow segment
eligible_population.denominator_event: eligible work item enters the target queue

baseline.source: canonical template fixture; replace with target-environment evidence

value_case.attribution_method: Compare the eligible workflow segment against its measured baseline

risk.evidence: Threat and policy review not yet completed

constraints: Remain in discovery until baseline and verifier evidence are complete

stop_conditions: No trustworthy verifier or accountable owner can be established
Required source access or effect controls cannot meet the declared risk ceiling

decision.rationale: The candidate needs measured value, context, integration, and adoption evidence

assumptions.statement: Operators will use the proposed workflow surface for eligible work
assumptions.validation_method: Observe representative cases and run a measured pilot
